title: Perfect state transfer in Grover walks on normal Cayley graphs
abstract: A Cayley graph $\operatorname{Cay}(Γ,S)$ over a finite group $Γ$ is said to be normal if its connection set $S$ is a union of some conjugacy classes of $Γ$. This paper investigates perfect state transfer in Grover walks on normal Cayley graphs. The Grover walk is a widely studied discrete-time quantum walk. We establish a necessary and sufficient condition for the occurrence of perfect state transfer on normal Cayley graphs. As applications, we derive explicit spectral criteria for perfect state transfer on Cayley graphs over abelian groups, dicyclic groups, and dihedral groups. These results yield several infinite families of Cayley graphs exhibiting perfect state transfer. We further obtain simple combinatorial characterizations of the existence of perfect state transfer on Cayley graphs over dihedral and dicyclic groups. Our general characterization also recovers a number of previously known results as special cases. As a further consequence, we obtain a complete characterization of perfect state transfer on unitary Cayley graphs. In particular, we prove that exactly four graphs in the class of unitary Cayley graphs exhibit perfect state transfer.
summary: This paper rigorously determines the necessary and sufficient spectral conditions for Perfect State Transfer (PST) when using Grover walks on normal Cayley graphs. By applying group theory and spectral analysis, it derives explicit criteria for various families of graphs, culminating in a complete classification showing that only four unitary Cayley graphs exhibit this phenomenon.
main_problem: The paper investigates the conditions for Perfect State Transfer (PST) occurring during Grover walks on a specific class of graphs called normal Cayley graphs.
main_result: A necessary and sufficient condition for PST is established, leading to complete characterizations for unitary Cayley graphs, proving that exactly four such graphs exhibit this property.
method: The analysis heavily relies on spectral graph theory, utilizing the eigenvalues of a derived 'discriminant matrix' ($P$) and relating PST conditions to Chebyshev polynomials evaluated at these eigenvalues.
model_or_system: The system models quantum walks governed by the Grover walk operator $U$ on a normal Cayley graph $	ext{Cay}(\Gamma, S)$ over a finite group $\Gamma$. The state space is defined over the symmetric arcs of this graph.
key_observables: Perfect State Transfer (PST) between vertices at time $	au$, and the periodicity of the quantum walk dynamics.
important_parameters: The structure of the underlying finite group $\Gamma$ (e.g., abelian, dicyclic, dihedral), the connection set $S$, and the time step $	au$.
main_assumptions: The analysis is restricted to normal Cayley graphs, and the focus is on transfer between specific 'vertex-type states.'

paper_structure: The paper progresses by defining PST on normal Cayley graphs, deriving general spectral conditions using representation theory (Theorem 3.4), applying these criteria to specific group structures like abelian, dicyclic, and dihedral groups, and concluding with a complete characterization for unitary Cayley graphs.
why_interesting: Quantum walks are fundamental models in quantum computation and quantum communication networks. Establishing precise mathematical conditions for PST provides concrete graph-theoretic tools applicable to designing robust quantum information channels.
